hypothesis: The r5b parent is materially better on pretraining records than on validation records, so its large frozen-validation deficit is primarily a record-distribution generalization failure rather than a universal inability to fit the acoustic field.
expected_mechanism: The r5b lineage repeatedly selected checkpoints on a fixed 48-record train gate while the architecture retained record-specific medium and source encodings. This can reward in-split fitting without guaranteeing transfer to new source-medium records.
primary_metric: global_energy_relative_l2 over the same 32 exact stored frames and same records for r5b and PI-DeepONet
primary_prediction: r5b global-energy relative L2 is lower than PI-DeepONet on the fresh-to-gate train panel
failure_signal: r5b global-energy relative L2 is not lower than PI-DeepONet, or target/time-index equality fails
secondary_diagnostics: family global-energy and mean-record relative L2
rollback: Read-only diagnostic. Preserve all r5b, CPADC, A3, B2-H, and Helmholtz checkpoints; do not promote any new checkpoint from this audit.
